ecb.rate_limit_basis: No documented limit; self-imposed guard. The ECB asks for updatedAfter/If-Modified-Since on frequent syncs, so poll no more than every 15 minutes.

fx.description: ECB reference rate (14:15 CET fixing, published ~16:00 CET); crosses derived via EUR. Information only, not a tradable quote.
fx.as_of_label: ECB 14:15 CET fix, {date} (daily, not a tradable quote)
fx.note_last_n: 3 observations per currency so the previous complete fixing date is still there when the newest date is incomplete. SEK is fetched only for the USD index replica.

usd_index_replica.label: USD index replica (ICE DXY formula) — ECB fix, derived by this app
usd_index_replica.as_of_label: ECB 14:15 CET fix, {date} (daily replica, not live; not ICE's index)
usd_index_replica.note: ICE publishes the formula (FX Indexes Methodology v3.0 s.5.1; weights constant since 1973). The value is a replica computed by this app from the ECB 14:15 CET fix (about 08:15 ET, before US data), never called 'U.S. Dollar Index', 'Dollar Index' or 'USDX' (ICE trademarks; ICE claims rights over the formulation). Mean absolute gap vs a NY-noon replica: about 0.13%.

bls.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
bls.rate_limit_basis: Unregistered: 25 queries/day, 25 series and 10 years per query, 50 requests per 10 s (bls.gov/developers/api_faqs.htm). The guard keeps 5 queries/day of headroom; all series go into one query.

treasury_fiscal.attribution: Source: U.S. Treasury, Daily Treasury Statement (Fiscal Data)
treasury_fiscal.note: DTS for day D is published about 16:00 ET on D+1. Since the DTS format change the closing-balance line carries its figure in open_today_bal while close_today_bal is 'null'.

release_poll.note: EVR-4: right after a mapped scheduled release (event_risk.release_documents.classes[...].series) the release watch loop polls the providers that serve those series, at most max_polls times per calendar row and poll_seconds apart, so the outcome is attached within minutes instead of at the next official_data cadence (the keyless BLS API is otherwise polled at most every two hours). 'providers' maps a series id prefix ('bls:CES0000000001' -> 'bls') to the provider name and the method that fetches its series. A targeted BLS poll counts against the same daily budget as the regular one.

eia_wpsr.rate_limit_basis: No documented limit for the release files; self-imposed guard (one weekly release).

eia_spot.price_source: Refinitiv, an LSEG business (per the EIA table definitions)
eia_spot.rate_limit_basis: No documented limit; the page changes once a week (Wednesday). Conditional GET (If-Modified-Since, EIA answers 304); the runtime polls hourly at most.
eia_spot.note: Daily closing spot prices, published weekly (Wednesday, through Tuesday), so the latest value is 1 to 8 days old. The date is authoritative; the time is the nominal US close. Rows are located by the series code in the history link, never by the row text.

fred.attribution: Source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
fred.rate_limit_basis: Documented: up to 120 requests per minute before HTTP 429 (fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/errors.html).

release_calendar.note: Fallback schedule for the BLS releases when the BLS ICS cannot be read (no contact User-Agent, or BLS refuses): FRED release/dates give dates only, the clock time is the agency standard release time configured here.
release_calendar.note_release_ids: Release ids verified live on 2026-09-27 with GET /fred/releases: 10 Consumer Price Index, 50 Employment Situation, 46 Producer Price Index, 192 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, 11 Employment Cost Index.
release_calendar.time_basis: FRED release calendar date + {agency} standard release time {time} ET (configured)
release_calendar.attribution: Source: FRED release calendar, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (schedule of the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics)

fred.quote_as_of_label: FRED daily close {date} (FRED lags its source)
fred.api_notice: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
fred.quote_note: FRED observations of these series become daily-close quotes (docs/MARKET_COVERAGE.md). The date is authoritative; the time is the nominal US close. DTWEXBGS (Fed broad dollar index) is never mapped onto DXY. FRED API terms: the app must show api_notice wherever FRED values appear. Every quote attribution names the owner and ends in 'via FRED'; SP500 and NASDAQCOM carry the owner's copyright notice (FRED tags them 'copyrighted: pre-approval required'), no licence is implied.
fred.restricted_series_note: ICE BofA OAS series (BAMLH0A0HYM2, BAMLC0A0CM) are internal-use only under ICE terms; not configured here. BAA10Y is the displayed credit-spread input.

ecb.basis: ECB deposit facility rate; 2Y from the euro area AAA curve (not the Schatz)

central_bank_meetings.note: GET /api/fx next meetings: each bank's next RATE DECISION from the stored calendar (rows with is_decision true of the bank, or of its event_class). Speeches, testimony, minutes and statements never count. A bank with a null event_class has no rate-decision calendar source in this app, which the API says instead of guessing. id = the decision.fx_banks bank id.
